# AI Knowledge Web

> Native JavaScript knowledge workbench for AI Knowledge Java: capability-gated PDF/TXT/MD upload, asynchronous parsing/indexing tasks, grounded text answers for the full library or complete selected scope, and current-authorized citation rereads. Current workspace 0006 is locally implemented and browser-verified against current Java sources with isolated Spring/SQLite and loopback model/vector protocol fixtures; it is not committed, pushed or deployed. Real-provider/Milvus quality, multimodal web integration and production remain incomplete. Java owns ACL, retrieval, models and evidence authority.

- [README](README.md): capabilities and local startup
- [AI Context](docs/AI_CONTEXT.md): source map and implementation boundaries
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and trust boundaries
- [API Connection](docs/API_CONNECTION.md): Java connection and allowed routes
- [Agent Instructions](AGENTS.md): versioned AI-Native workflow
- [Verification](docs/VERIFICATION.md): actual evidence and limitations
- [Provenance](docs/PROVENANCE.md): historical export and explicit earlier asset synchronization; no automatic Java asset sync
- [Current Change](docs/changes/0006-grounded-answers/spec.md): grounded text answers, complete scope and server-source contract
- [Current Verification](docs/changes/0006-grounded-answers/verification.md): local browser flow, 139 passing tests and unverified production boundaries
- [Security](SECURITY.md): secrets, cookies and local-only transport
- [Backend](https://github.com/LingBengYing/ai-knowledge): Java authority and persistence

This navigation file does not guarantee search-engine indexing or model ingestion.
